'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] recapture the town of [[Vysokopillia]] in [[Kherson Oblast]], which has been under [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian occupation]] since March, and raise the [[Flag of Ukraine|Ukrainian flag]] over the town's hospital. [https://www.newsweek.com/ukraine-recaptures-kherson-village-russia-raises-flag-over-hospital-1739725 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Six [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] and a civilian driver are injured when three gunmen open fire on a bus in [[Nablus]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. Two of the attackers are later arrested. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/shots-fired-at-israeli-bus-in-jordan-valley-at-least-two-moderately-hurt (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[Syrian Air Force]] helicopter crashes in [[Hama]], [[Syria]], killing all of the people on board. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-military-helicopter-crashes-hama-crew-is-killed-state-media-2022-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*A private [[2022 Baltic Sea Cessna crash|Cessna 551 crashes]] into the [[Baltic Sea]], off the coast of [[Latvia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62789877 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Saskatchewan stabbings]]
**Ten people are killed and fifteen others injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at the [[James Smith Cree Nation]] and the nearby village of [[Weldon, Saskatchewan|Weldon]] in [[Saskatchewan]], [[Canada]]. The two suspects remain at large. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/saskatchewan/saskatchewan-rcmp-dangerous-persons-alert-stabbings-1.6572464 (CBC News)]
*[[Hamas]] authorities [[capital punishment|execute]] five [[Palestinians]] in the first executions in [[Palestinian territories]] since 2017. Two of those executed were accused of [[espionage]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-authorities-execute-five-palestinians-gaza-2022-09-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Chilean national plebiscite]]
**By a margin of 62% to 38%, [[Chileans]] vote to reject the [[Proposed Political Constitution of the Republic of Chile, 2022|new proposed constitution]] drafted by the [[Constitutional Convention (Chile)|Constitutional Convention]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/05/chile-votes-overwhelmingly-to-reject-new-progressive-constitution (''The Guardian'')]
